checks.name: Calendar defaults to list without changing the stored view preference
Existing week preference is honored and all four view controls remain available
Source filters remove events, persist selection and can show the all-hidden state
Disconnected sources cannot appear or be enabled; zero connected accounts is handled
Multi-day all-day events are listed once and end dates remain exclusive
Timed events ending at midnight are excluded on their ending day
List includes the selected date through month end and excludes the following month
List ordering is chronological, with all-day events before timed events on a date
Pagination shows five distinct entries per page and clamps both ends
Changed source membership resets pagination rather than leaving a later page empty
Selecting a date resets the list page and closes the compact date picker
List arrows navigate month starts across years without date overflow
Mini-calendar month navigation preserves the date and results until a date is chosen
Today restores the demo date, selector month and timeline scroll while preserving view
Day, week and month period arrows preserve their respective navigation units
Daily agenda selection toggles an existing visible event and ignores unknown identifiers
Opening a listed event uses its matching details and preserves calendar context
Linked-note and new-note actions call the existing note flows after closing event details
Related-task action preserves event and project context in the existing task dialog
Calendar connections keep the existing integrations route
